runs.detail: measurement completed; no quality or speed threshold asserted

metric_notes.scene_gpu_ms: Includes metadata and reservoir passes; excludes readback and scene updates. Do not add component times.
metric_notes.render_update_wall_ms: Blocking update and render, including waits, readback and products.
metric_notes.convergence: Static: RMS across sequences of each prefix mean's error to the independent integral. CPU averaging only. Moving: null.
metric_notes.ensemble: Static averages all frames and sequences; moving averages only the final frame across independent sequences. Finite-sample errors are not proof of bias.
metric_notes.residual_frame_delta_rmse: Fresh frame difference minus matching reference difference; excludes sequence boundaries. Temporal correlation can reduce it without improving convergence.
metric_notes.reference_split_rmse: Difference of disjoint equal-spp NEE/MIS halves; the stored reference is their mean. Reference noise is not subtracted.
metric_notes.memory: Fresh renderer per case. Reservoir and metadata bytes include host mirrors; scene pool backing excludes targets. Total VRAM is unavailable.
metric_notes.timestamps: Unavailable or inapplicable GPU series and cumulative times are null.
